notes.title: Scribble Wolf Open Beta Test started! Sorry for the immediate bug;(
notes.notes:
Open Beta Test has started!
You can join it by clicking the “Request Access” or “Play Now” button on the store page.

I would appreciate it if you could post your comments/suggestions/bug reports on the discussion board!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3539320/discussions/

Streaming and posts for SNS are totally acceptable! In fact, we'd rather ask you to do so! POG!

I would like to end the Open Beta Test when the time is right, but I plan to hold it for at least a month.

[b][u]About the bug[/u][/b]
If you played the game before about 4:00, there was a bug that caused the game to hang up after pressing the “Start Tutorial” button.
What a mess...

A fixed version is now available. Apologies!

If you were unable to play the tutorial, press
Menu button (top right of screen) → How to Play → Start Tutorial
to check the tutorial.
